# Compute most common genre for each playlist and update titles
for pl in all_playlists:
    song_ids = pl['song_ids']
    genre_counts = {}
    for sid in song_ids:
        genre = song_genres[str(sid)]
        genre_counts[genre] = genre_counts.get(genre, 0) + 1
    # Find most common genre (if tie, pick the one with highest count, then alphabetically first)
    most_common = max(sorted(genre_counts.keys()), key=lambda g: genre_counts[g])
    new_title = f"{pl['title']} | {most_common}"
    print(f"Updating playlist {pl['playlist_id']}: '{pl['title']}' -> '{new_title}'")
    result = apis.spotify.update_playlist(playlist_id=pl['playlist_id'], access_token=access_token, title=new_title)
    print(result)
